candidate_pool.instruction: Resume a persisted pending candidate before reselection and withhold credit until terminal readback.
Persist staged scores, but choose a fresh candidate again at the start of every invocation.
If a staged candidate is uncertain, use an external evaluator to decide whether it survives.

Persist the exact survivor set and stage cursor, resume those survivors before any reselection after restart, treat transport failures as non-semantic, and withhold credit until independent terminal readback.

fatal_gates.F2: no external API/model, hosted compute, richer-mode, protected-primary, manual-user step or finite quota

guards: resume exact survivor set before reselection

stage_1_score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0; otherwise one point per stage-1 guard PASS; ties stable lexical id.
stage_2_rule: Do not precompute stage-2 scores in this invocation. Later invocation must reconstruct this precommit and the durable stage-1 state, resume the exact survivor set before any new family selection/public semantic read, then evaluate only the precommitted stage-2 guards.
